messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: primary-us-west GPU pool reached 100% allocation (pool-primary-usw-3). Autoscaler attempted 3 scaleups but failed with quota error: "insufficient_project_quota: GPUs vCPU limit exceeded". Queue depth increasing (q=12k -> 18k in 15m). Affected routes: /v1/generate (high QPS) and /v1/chat. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/gpu-queue
jess_oncall: I'm on it, paging SRE and runtime. @aman_sre @kim_runtime can you grab logs and confirm autoscaler failure mode? any immediate customer impact known?
aman_sre: grabbing logs now. quick snapshot:
```
[autoscaler] 2026-04-11T10:12:03Z Attempting scale +8 GPUs -> failed
error: quota_exceeded: request for 8 A100s would exceed project quota (region: us-west1)
[orchestrator] spillover policy triggered -> attempted route to eu-west but weight=0 for model variants using A100-ssm
```
Looks like two factors: cloud quota prevents fast scale, and cross-region steer blocked for some variants due to compatibility flags.
kim_runtime: runtime traces show route decision: primary->fallback attempted but route algebra rejected because model-variant-id didn't exist in eu-west pool (we didn't onboard q4-8-bit variant there). snippets:
```
route_eval(req) -> prefer: primary-usw
if primary overloaded -> try routes in order [eu-west, east1]
eu-west candidate: model_variant(q4_8, a100) missing -> skip
fallthrough -> east1 candidate present but route weight currently 0. final: enqueue in primary queue
```
We also see high KV cache miss rate causing extra compute per request.
luis_engops: we just hit regional GPU quota. I can request emergency quota bump but GCP approvals are slow. Shorter-term: I can flip on the dedicated reserved fallback pool (eu-west-hot-standby) we've been keeping cold, will need ~6m to spin up. Starting now.
raj_support: support telemetry: ~18% of high-tier customer requests to /v1/chat returned 429/503 in last 10m. Several active tickets from two enterprise customers with elevated latency alerts. No data exfiltration. Notifying CS.
emily_pm: need mitigation plan and a draft customer note. Also what's the minimal action to stop queue growth? Can we throttle heavy customers or move them to lighter model variants?
nora_cs: drafting short message for impacted customers: "We're experiencing capacity issues in US-WEST causing degraded throughput. We're actively rerouting workloads and expect improvement within 30-60 minutes. No data loss." will share once we have firm ETA.
aman_sre: mitigation proposals (short-term ordered):
1) manual route weight change: steer 30% of eligible traffic to eu-west for compatible variants (if variant mismatch, skip those requests).
2) enable eu-west-hot-standby reserved pool (luis said ~6m).
3) apply per-customer fair-share throttles for top 10 heaviest API keys (temporary rate_limit at proxy layer).
4) reduce default batch size for largest models to lower GPU memory pressure (runtime config toggle).
5) fallback to smaller model-variant (q4_0) for non-enterprise plans.
Pick 1+3+4 to stop immediate growth.
jess_oncall: let's do 1 + 3 + 4 now. @luis_engops start hot-standby boot. @kim_runtime apply batch-size override. @aman_sre coordinate manual route change. I'll update customers.
kim_runtime: applying batch-size override to heavy models: turning max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 1024 for models: gptx-64b, gptx-32b (affects latency but reduces memory). Command:
```
POST /internal/runtime/config
{
  "target_models": ["gptx-64b","gptx-32b"],
  "overrides": {"max_batch_tokens": 1024}
}
```
Patch in progress, pushing to 60% of nodes to observe.
aman_sre: executing manual route change using control-plane API. cURL:
```
curl -X POST https://control.internal/api/v1/route-adjust \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"service":"inference","policy":"manual","targets":[{"region":"eu-west","weight":30},{"region":"east1","weight":10}] }'
```
Applying now.
luis_engops: hot-standby boot started at 10:19Z. ETA ~7m. also opened quota request with cloud ops (case #CLOUD-8921) but don't expect approval in <1h.
raj_support: applied top-10 API key throttles (20% rate reduction) at 10:22Z. Notified their SRE contacts.
jess_oncall: status check 10:27Z — queue depth: 18k -> 13k, p95 latency for /v1/chat high-tier: 2.1s -> 1.4s, error rate down from 18% -> 9%. Good progress. Keep changes for now and monitor.
aman_sre: route change telemetry: eu-west traffic now at ~27% of eligible requests. We still see variant skips: 12% of requests can't be routed to eu-west due to variant mismatch; those remain in primary.
kim_runtime: batch-size change rolled to 60% nodes. Early memory pressure reduced, instance evictions down.
luis_engops: hot-standby pool reporting ready at 10:26Z. Injecting on-demand reservation to accept compatible variants. Provisioned additional 12 A100-equivalents.
jess_oncall: confirm whether we should also enable east1? pros/cons?
aman_sre: east1 has lower capacity and a keep-frozen flag due to region-specific kernels; enabling would require a small model-recompile for some variants. I'd avoid if not necessary.
emily_pm: for customer comms: mention mitigation steps and ETA window. Nora, add note that enterprise SRE have been contacted and we offered temporary token-level throttles.
nora_cs: message drafted and sent to impacted customers at 10:30Z. Link: https://internal/cs/msgs/171820
raj_support: ticket update: customers A and B acknowledged mitigation; B requested SLA credit pathway — forwarding to finance.
jess_oncall: current snapshot 10:33Z: queue 13k -> 9.2k, error rate 9% -> 4.5%, p95 latency 1.4s -> 1.1s. Hot-standby absorbing ~20% of surfacing workload. Good.
aman_sre: root cause summary so far: autoscaler attempted scale but blocked by cloud quota; traffic routing to fallback regions was partially blocked because not all model variants were onboarded to fallback regions; KV cache cold starts amplified load. Postmortem actions: ramp up cross-region model onboarding, pre-warm KV caches, add quota guardrails and earlier degrade to lightweight variants.
jess_oncall: action items before handoff (I will hand off to night oncall in 4h):
- Keep manual route weights for 30/10 for 2h and then reassess (jess_oncall)
- Finish model-variant rollout to eu-west (luis_engops + runtime)
- Create automated throttle playbook for top API keys (aman_sre)
- Complete customer incident note and post to status page (nora_cs)
- Follow up on cloud quota case C-8921 (luis_engops)
I'll do a formal handoff at 14:30Z with a short summary.
emily_pm: add post-incident evaluation to tomorrow's incident review. we'll look at cost vs latency tradeoffs for pre-warming reserved capacity.
nora_cs: final note to customers posted at 10:40Z. will update with RCA when available.
jess_oncall: handing off in 2m to @night_oncall (summary: primary-us-west GPU quota exhausted, autoscaler blocked, manual traffic steering and batch-size overrides reduced load, hot-standby brought online, error rates falling. watch queue and quota case). :white_check_mark:
night_oncall: acknowledged. I'll take it from here. tagging this thread for incident review."
